source_title: Before and After: Compare Photo — US App Store
observation: The listing showed about 2.1K ratings and a 4.7 rating for a dedicated before-and-after comparison workflow, supporting a real but smaller behavior than generic slideshow creation.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: Ratings do not disclose downloads, revenue, retention or use-case mix.

source_title: BeforeAfter: Instant Watermark — US App Store
observation: A second dedicated before-after app showed about 2.2K ratings and a 4.8 rating, indicating discoverable category intent across more than one product.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: Category presence does not prove a repeatable acquisition channel for a new vertical-video app.

source_title: Before & After Video Maker — offline one-time iOS app
observation: A newly listed 5.5 MB app advertises offline processing, no data collection and a $3.99 one-time price, showing the bounded local implementation is feasible while weakening any claim that privacy alone is a durable wedge.
limitations: The app is too new for meaningful rating evidence and listing claims were not independently tested.

source_title: Before and After Video Maker — subscription iOS listing
observation: Another new listing displayed $7.99 weekly, $19.99 monthly and $99.99 lifetime options but lacked meaningful rating evidence, demonstrating aggressive pricing rather than validated payments.
denominator: in-app purchase options shown on listing
limitations: Price architecture is not proof of transactions, conversion or acceptable value.

observation: The observed listing emphasizes manual photo comparison; a 2-24-photo sequence with anchor-based auto-alignment, dates and one-tap 9:16 export is a specific testable workflow rather than a generic visual redesign.
denominator: features represented on one listing at access
limitations: App listings may omit features; the gap is not a durable advantage until users prefer it in a task test.

observation: The listing describes multiple progress contexts, supporting a repeat cycle for users with ongoing fitness, renovation, restoration or creative projects.
limitations: No product-specific D30 or second-project retention was observed.

source_title: US iPhone Photo & Video free chart
observation: Multiple creator and short-form media apps remained visible in the current US Photo & Video chart, supporting ongoing vertical-media creation demand but not a unique before-after window.
denominator: US iPhone Photo & Video free chart
limitations: Adjacent category activity is only a timing proxy.

observation: The proposed scope operates on user-selected media, keeps processing local, has no public feed and avoids health-outcome claims; sensitive-body-photo handling remains an implementation requirement.
limitations: Scope is not proof of privacy implementation or of user consent for every photo.
